from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
    upper, lower = grid[:sep], grid[sep+1:]
    lbg = Counter(x for row in lower for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if a == b else lbg for a, b in zip(arow, brow)] for arow, brow in zip(upper, lower)]
